name: DISCO distills tree search into a robot policy that plans long-horizon tasks with no search at test time (CoRL 2026 best paper finalist)
title: DISCO distills tree search into a robot policy that plans long-horizon tasks with no search at test time (CoRL 2026 best paper finalist)
summary: DISCO runs Monte Carlo Tree Search over continuous actions in simulation and keeps distilling what it finds into a policy that runs directly, so deployment needs no search. Strong results on long-horizon packing and stacking, with real-world transfer. Oral at CoRL on Nov 10.
